title: A Rivergate for the Trail
author: Ivo Kavanagh
blurb: Isandro Almeida, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
